title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
observed: After walking to (7,6) and pressing pause, the pause menu is open but btn-resume reports top=false, so something else sits on top of it at its centre. The 'Key collected' toast is still visible at that moment.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it. The toast must not overlap the pause menu's Resume button.

title: Spike hit at score 0 wraps score to 65036 and later goes negative
observed: Score is 0 when the player dashes onto spikes at (1,1)-adjacent tile. The score jumps to 65036 (0 minus 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit), and on the next coin it shows -400. Score is never clamped at 0.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative; score must stay within 0..999,999.

title: Double dash in one tick moves 3 tiles and HUD coin counter is stale
observed: Sending dash-down+dash-down in one tick moves the player from (1,1) to (1,4), three tiles, although a dash is at most two tiles and only one move per tick is allowed. The coin is collected (state coins=1) but the HUD still shows Coins 0/5.
expected: Only the last movement key counts, so the player moves at most one dash of two tiles (to (1,3)). The HUD must always show the current coin count.

title: Restart level from pause menu leaves game paused and resets timer while paused
observed: With the game paused, click:btn-restart resets the timer to 300 and the events show restart, but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu stays open.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so mode should be 'playing'.

title: Restart level leaves game paused; the game then sits frozen behind the pause menu
observed: After esc and click:btn-restart, the state resets (score 0, lives 3, time 300) but mode remains 'paused' with the pause menu still open. Waiting afterwards changes nothing until the player presses Resume.
expected: After Restart level the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing') and the pause menu is hidden.

title: Pausing on a tick still moves the player (rest of tick input not ignored)
observed: Tick 0 'pause+down': the game became paused and the player still moved from (1,1) to (1,2) with a move event.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (1,1) and nothing else should happen in that tick.

title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
observed: After 'dash-down+dash-down' the state shows coins=1 but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5', and it remains stale on the paused tick.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Spike hit makes score jump to 65136, then go negative
observed: Stepping onto spikes at tick 6 changed score from 100 to 65136 instead of subtracting 500. A later coin then showed score -300.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points, clamped at 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit. Score must never be negative or wrap around.

title: HUD coin counter stale after dash pickup; score later goes negative
observed: At tick 3 'dash-right' collected a coin (state coins=1) but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'. Later the score wraps to 65136 after spikes and reaches -800 at tick 18.
expected: The HUD should show the current coin count (1/5). Score must stay within 0..999,999, with spikes subtracting 500 clamped at 0.
